text: Residents in Harbor Ward must boil water. Residents in Hill Ward must avoid roads.
Residents in Sector Alpha must shelter indoors. Residents in Sector Beta must evacuate.
Factory workers must evacuate. Nearby residents must shelter indoors.
Children must avoid roads. Adults must boil water.
Residents in East Canal must evacuate if water rises above 45 cm. Residents in West Canal must evacuate if water rises above 15 cm.
Residents must evacuate, except emergency personnel. Visitors must avoid roads, except drivers.
Residents may evacuate. Visitors must shelter indoors.
Drivers should avoid roads. Residents must boil water.
Residents must shelter indoors after 5 PM.
Residents must evacuate or must shelter indoors. Visitors must avoid roads or must boil water.
Residents must turn off the gas supply, then evacuate. Visitors must boil water, then shelter indoors.
